recommendation.title: Attack recommendation

verdict.insufficient: Not enough evidence for a recommendation
verdict.favorable: Conditions look favorable for another attack

detail.limited: Recent readable reports offer a favorable signal. Keep your commitment limited and review the result before spending more turns.
detail.caution: Recent readable reports suggest resistance or a previous defeat. Gather more intelligence before committing heavily.
detail.conflicting: Recent reports point in different directions. Review the sources before deciding.
detail.stale: The available reports have lost too much confidence to support a current assessment. Gather fresh intelligence.
detail.insufficient: No usable recent defense estimate or personal battle outcome supports an assessment.
detail.favorable: A recent convincing battle result, or supporting intel and battle evidence, favors another attack. Review the sources and choose your commitment.

recommendation.caveat: Evidence loses confidence with time: faster while the defender is active. We use up to five readable reports from the last 24 hours. Armies, equipment, forts and protection can change. Guidance is not a win probability or a turn recommendation.
recommendation.gatherIntel: Gather new spy intelligence or review your recent battle reports. You can still choose your attack manually.

activity.online: Defender is online. Evidence confidence declines faster.
activity.recent: Defender was recently active. Evidence confidence declines at an elevated rate.
activity.offline: Defender is offline. Evidence still ages; earlier activity continues to count.
activity.unknown: Defender activity is unavailable. Evidence ages conservatively.

quality.decisive: Low own casualties with a strong damage exchange
quality.ordinary: Battle result supports only limited confidence
quality.unknown: Not enough battle detail to judge casualty efficiency
